### How it works
Helps event organizers who sell on Weezevent send practical information without exporting lists. Every 15 minutes, the workflow fetches the new participants with their form answers, saves them as Bi-way contacts, and sends them an RCS card when the registration form asks for a phone number, or an email otherwise.

**Limits:** Weezevent grants API keys to its partners: ask them for one. Only new registrations are fetched, up to 500 per run. The memory of the last run only works in published runs, not in manual tests. RCS only reaches French mobile operators, and the email needs an email channel on your account, chosen in **Send the email**.

### Setup
1. Install the verified **Bi-way** community node (`n8n-nodes-biway-messenger`, [instructions](https://github.com/pocket-communication/n8n-nodes-biway-messenger#installation)). Tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.45.4 and n8n Cloud 3.1.0.
2. Create a **Bi-Way API** credential with an API key from Bi-way › Settings › Security.
3. Get a Weezevent access token once, with your login, password and API key ([how](https://docapi.weezevent.com/#/legacy/v3?id=post-authaccess_token)). It stays valid: the workflow never logs in. In **Get new participants**, create a **Custom Auth** credential: `{"qs": {"api_key": "…", "access_token": "…"}}`, and replace `YOUR_EVENT_ID`.
4. Check the RCS agent with the Bi-way node: RCS Agent › Get Status.
5. Adapt the card and the email: `YOUR EVENT`, `YOUR VENUE`, coordinates and practical information link. Publish the workflow.

### Customization
Change the frequency in **Every 15 minutes**, the field names **Find the phone number** looks for if your form names the phone field differently, and the contact group of the event in **Save the participant**. Add your poster to the cards, from your Bi-way gallery or a URL. A fallback SMS written in the node holds 114 characters with the STOP mention and chat link; turn them off in **Fallback SMS Options** for up to 160.

![Workflow overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pocket-communication/n8n-nodes-biway-messenger/main/examples/images/weezevent-ticket-holders-nodes.png#full-width)

## Fetch new participants
Asks Weezevent for the participants registered since the last run, with their form answers, and skips those already handled.

## Save the contact
The phone number comes from the form, if it asks for one. Contacts are matched by email.

## Send the information
An RCS card with a phone number, the same card by email without one.
